text: Instrument apps with OpenTelemetry and send traces, logs, and metrics to Honeycomb
quote: Instrument your applications with OpenTelemetry, the open-source standard for collecting telemetry, and send traces, logs, and metrics to Honeycomb.

text: Receives telemetry via OTLP over gRPC, HTTP/protobuf, and HTTP/JSON
quote: Honeycomb supports receiving telemetry data via OpenTelemetry’s native protocol, OTLP, over gRPC, HTTP/protobuf, and HTTP/JSON.

text: Query Builder lets you construct queries against your data for investigation
quote: Query Builder allows you to construct queries against your data to produce results for investigation and further exploration.

text: Query Assistant generates Honeycomb queries from natural-language input
quote: Query Assistant is a feature that generates Honeycomb queries based on your natural language query (NLQ) input.

text: Boards let you save, organize, and share analysis components around an objective
quote: A Board is a workspace where you can save, organize, and share analysis components focused on a common objective.

text: Triggers send alerts when user-defined thresholds are crossed
quote: Use triggers to send alerts when thresholds that you define and configure are passed.

text: SLOs define service delivery agreements and alert when error budget is threatened
quote: Use Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to define an agreement regarding delivery of a given service and be alerted when your SLO budget is threatened.

text: Triggers and SLOs can route notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or a custom webhook
quote: Set up Triggers and SLOs to alert your team when conditions are met, and route notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or a custom webhook.

text: Connects to any MCP-compatible AI agent so it can query telemetry and investigate issues using live data
quote: Connect Honeycomb to any AI agent that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so it can query your telemetry, investigate issues, and answer questions using your live Honeycomb data.

text: AI agent can investigate/diagnose latency or error spikes and identify performance outliers with optimization suggestions
quote:
They can:

*   Investigate and diagnose latency or error spikes
*   Identify performance outliers and suggest optimization opportunities

text: API lets you programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, and API keys
quote: Build integrations and automate workflows with the Honeycomb API. Programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more.

text: SDK example shows creating a span, adding attributes, and closing it when work completes
quote: This example creates a span, adds context as attributes, and closes it when the work is done

text: Offers a free-forever introductory plan
quote: Our introductory plan, free forever.

text: Already-instrumented OpenTelemetry apps can send OTLP data directly to Honeycomb without re-instrumenting
quote: If your application is already instrumented with OpenTelemetry, you can send OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) data directly to Honeycomb.

text: Queries support up to six clauses: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT, HAVING
quote: A query in Honeycomb consists of up to six clauses

text: Relational field span prefixes (root., parent., child., anyX.) let you query across trace structure
quote: Relational field span prefixes follow your trace structure and include: root., parent., child., anyX.

text: Custom integrations can receive JSON payloads pushed by Honeycomb when alerts fire
quote: This allows you to build custom integrations that receive JSON payloads from Honeycomb upon alerts firing.

text: Pre-configured Board Templates are available for common use cases to save setup time
quote: we offer pre-configured Board Templates for common use cases... saving you time that would otherwise be spent building Boards manually.

text: OpenAPI spec can be downloaded for use with your own tooling
quote: You can download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec to use with your own tooling.

text: SLO values are tracked past retention period, shown in Budget Burndown and Historical Compliance graphs
quote: Honeycomb will track SLO values past your retention period, but will display these for only the Budget Burndown and Historical Compliance graphs.

text: Can translate existing dashboards and alerts from other tools into Honeycomb's query language
quote: Translate existing dashboards and alerts into Honeycomb's query language

text: BubbleUp feature helps surface anomalies/outliers in your data
quote:
BubbleUp

![Checkmark]

text: Free plan supports up to 20M events and 100M metrics data points per month
quote: Event Volume: Up to 20M per month Metrics Data Points: Up to 100M per month
